caption: The drawing depicts a straight-on view of a settee with a squared-off back and arms that curve gently outward. The settee has four legs, each of which is finely carved and tapers downward, with small metal casters or wheels at the feet. The wood components, including the top rail, legs, and arms, are brown with intricate carvings, particularly along the upper back where a geometric and botanical pattern is visible. The seat, backrest, and the inner sides of the arms are upholstered in a light yellow-green fabric featuring a subtle, repeating pattern of squares and rectangles. The upholstery covers the seating surface, the inner back, and the side panels, creating a contrast with the darker wood frame. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, with no additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Sofa
